payload.model_patch:
diff --git a/sphinx/ext/autodoc/typehints.py b/sphinx/ext/autodoc/typehints.py
index 4f81a6eae..681ca7870 100644
--- a/sphinx/ext/autodoc/typehints.py
+++ b/sphinx/ext/autodoc/typehints.py
@@ -38,6 +38,36 @@ def record_typehints(app: Sphinx, objtype: str, name: str, obj: Any,
         pass
 
 
+def record_typehints_for_overloads(app: Sphinx, objtype: str, name: str, obj: Any,
+                                   options: Dict, args: str, retann: str) -> None:
+    """Record type hints for overloaded callables."""
+    if not callable(obj):
+        return
+
+    try:
+        overloads = inspect.get_overloads(obj)
+    except (TypeError, ValueError):
+        return
+
+    if not overloads:
+        return
+
+    annotations = app.env.temp_data.setdefault('annotations', {})
+    annotation = annotations.setdefault(name, OrderedDict())
+
+    for overload in overloads:
+        try:
+            sig = inspect.signature(overload)
+        except (TypeError, ValueError):
+            continue
+
+        for param in sig.parameters.values():
+            if param.annotation is not param.empty:
+                annotation[param.name] = typing.stringify(param.annotation)
+        if sig.return_annotation is not sig.empty:
+            annotation['return'] = typing.stringify(sig.return_annotation)
+
+
 def merge_typehints(app: Sphinx, domain: str, objtype: str, contentnode: Element) -> None:
     if domain != 'py':
         return
@@ -129,6 +159,7 @@ def modify_field_list(node: nodes.field_list, annotations: Dict[str, str]) -> No
 
 def setup(app: Sphinx) -> Dict[str, Any]:
     app.connect('autodoc-process-signature', record_typehints)
+    app.connect('autodoc-process-signature', record_typehints_for_overloads)
     app.connect('object-description-transform', merge_typehints)
 
     return {
